item.text: The repo is small and clean. I’m reading the loader, manifest, and tests together so the fix matches the intended API rather than adding extra behavior.

The current implementation fetches remote URLs directly and throws generic errors. I’m going to replace that with manifest resolution, keep direct local fixture loading, and normalize all missing/read/parse failures into `AssetLoadError` where appropriate.
I’m editing `src/assetLoader.mjs` only. The new flow will resolve a source to a local file path first, then decode from disk, so there is no code path that can call `fetch`.

The loader now has a local-only resolution path and an exported `AssetLoadError`. I’m running the existing tests, then I’ll add a few targeted tests for the hidden requirements if the current suite doesn’t cover them.
